reference_sql:
SELECT country_code,
       AVG(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur END) AS avg_web_line_eur,
       AVG(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN net_revenue_eur END) AS avg_store_line_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY country_code
alternatives: SELECT country_code, AVG(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') AS avg_web_line_eur, AVG(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'store') AS avg_store_line_eur FROM sales GROUP BY country_code

SELECT country_code, SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur END) AS avg_web_line_eur, SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN net_revenue_eur END) AS avg_store_line_eur FROM sales GROUP BY 1
